How to Use This Application Hub

01

Choose your application.

Start with the category that matches what you make. Review more than one path if your work spans several applications.

02

Compare technical information.

Use current technical data to compare the grades under review against your requirements.

03

Validate in your own system.

Check the grade in your formulation and process before making a specification decision.
